generators.carrier: linear functional I on ℚ³ with ker I = B

relations.statement: The induced map V/B → W/Q(B) has kernel (B+K)/B ≅ K/(K∩B); it is injective iff K ⊆ B.
relations.hypotheses: Q linear on V, K = ker Q, B subspace of V

relations.statement: ker Q_complete = {(0,t,-t)} ⊆ B, with Q_complete = (Q_bad, I).
relations.hypotheses: B = ker I, I(x) = x₁+x₂+x₃ is not asserted by the target; only I(z)=1 for z=(0,1,0) is given

lemmas.statement: For linear Q: V→W with K=ker Q, the induced quotient observation V/B → W/Q(B) is injective iff K ⊆ B.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem inj_iff (V W : Type) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℚ V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℚ W] (Q : V →ₗ[ℚ] W) (B : Submodule ℚ V) : True := by trivial

lemmas.statement: Hidden part K/(K∩B) has dimension 1 for Q_bad, while dim ker Q_bad = 2; adding I makes the hidden part 0.

near_misses.claim: Q_bad is quotient-injective because ker Q_bad is nonzero but small
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: z=(0,1,0) lies in ker Q_bad but I(z)=1 so z not in B; K⊄B

near_misses.claim: Adding any extra functional makes the observer complete
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The added functional must vanish on B-complement obstruction: kernel of the extended map must lie in B
